Continued from BR-58

Does any abnormal change occur in continuity when the connectors or wire harness of the speed sensor and intermediate connectors are twisted or bent?

YES (Abnormal change) → Faulty wire harness.

NO (No change)
↓

Is there foreign material or ferric chips on the sensor tip?

YES → Clean chips from the speed sensor.

NO
↓

Inspect the front axle hub serrations and sensor rotor serrations.
(See pages BR-67 and 70)
↓

Are the front axle hub serrations and sensor rotor serrations OK?

NO → Faulty front axle hub and/or sensor rotor.

YES
↓

Inspect the brake actuator operation.
(See page BR-61)
↓

Is actuator operation OK?

NO → Faulty brake actuator.

YES
↓

Replace the speed sensor.
(Inner magnet faulty)
